title: Causal Inference and Uplift Modelling: A Review of the Literature
authors: Pierre Gutierrez and Jean-Yves Gérardy
specific_claims: Organizes two-model, class-transformation and direct uplift approaches; connects transformed-outcome regression to effect-error objectives.
context_mechanism: Foundational taxonomy, not a context selector.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Transformed causal supervision predates foundation models.

title: A Literature Survey and Experimental Evaluation of the State-of-the-Art in Uplift Modeling: A Stepping Stone Toward the Development of Prescriptive Analytics
authors: Floris Devriendt and Darie Moldovan and Wouter Verbeke
specific_claims: Reviews uplift estimators and evaluation metrics and compares methods on four real datasets.
context_mechanism: No foundation-model context mechanism.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Application-specific evaluation and instability are established concerns.

title: Metalearners for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects using machine learning
authors: Sören R. Künzel and Jasjeet S. Sekhon and Peter J. Bickel and Bin Yu
specific_claims: Studies S/T/X meta-learning, introduces the X-learner, and evaluates treatment heterogeneity including field experiments.
context_mechanism: Meta-learning decomposes estimation into supervised tasks.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Strong S/T/X controls are required; no learner is uniformly best.

title: Quasi-oracle estimation of heterogeneous treatment effects
authors: Xinkun Nie and Stefan Wager
specific_claims: Uses estimated outcome and treatment residuals to isolate a causal regression objective, with quasi-oracle results in specified settings.
context_mechanism: R-learner objective rather than retrieval.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: A causal loss is a known component; compare teacher/R-learner policies.

title: Towards optimal doubly robust estimation of heterogeneous causal effects
authors: Edward H. Kennedy
specific_claims: Analyzes two-stage doubly robust CATE regression and oracle-error behavior under nuisance estimation.
context_mechanism: Regression using estimated pseudo-outcomes.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: DR supervision does not by itself constitute a new selector.

title: Double/debiased machine learning for treatment and structural parameters
authors: Victor Chernozhukov and Denis Chetverikov and Mert Demirer and Esther Duflo and Christian Hansen and Whitney Newey and James Robins
evidence_sections: Sections 1-3: regularization bias, sample splitting and orthogonality; Section 5: treatment effects
specific_claims: Combines Neyman-orthogonal scores and cross-fitting to limit nuisance regularization and overfitting bias for low-dimensional causal parameters.
context_mechanism: Sample splitting, not context-memory selection.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Honest nuisance fitting is established scaffolding; cross-fitting or independent nuisance data may be appropriate depending on design.

title: Orthogonal statistical learning
authors: Dylan J. Foster and Vasilis Syrgkanis
specific_claims: Gives excess-risk guarantees for two-stage learning with a nuisance component when the population risk satisfies orthogonality.
context_mechanism: General statistical-learning framework.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: A selector needs its own conditions; attaching DR labels is insufficient proof.

title: Doubly Robust Policy Evaluation and Learning
authors: Miroslav Dudík and John Langford and Lihong Li
evidence_sections: Sections 2-3: direct, IPS and DR policy evaluation; policy learning
specific_claims: Combines reward and logging-policy models for evaluation and optimization with logged contextual-bandit feedback.
context_mechanism: Offline policy evaluation; context means decision covariates.
label_compute_budget: Logged covariates, actions and factual rewards; offline evaluation/learning, no new reward acquisition.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: DR policy-value feedback and optimization are longstanding ideas.

title: Who Should Be Treated? Empirical Welfare Maximization Methods for Treatment Choice
authors: Toru Kitagawa and Aleksey Tetenov
evidence_sections: Empirical welfare criterion; capacity-constrained policy section; supplementary capacity analysis
specific_claims: Learns treatment rules by empirical welfare maximization and explicitly treats capacity constraints.
context_mechanism: Policy choice with treatment-capacity restrictions.
label_compute_budget: Experimental factual outcomes and known propensity; candidate treatment-rule class and capacity constraints.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Fixed treatment coverage and welfare maximization are established objectives.

title: Policy Learning With Observational Data
authors: Susan Athey and Stefan Wager
specific_claims: Optimizes constrained treatment policies using semiparametrically motivated doubly robust evaluation and derives regret guarantees.
context_mechanism: Policy class constraints, not FM row selection.
label_compute_budget: Observational factual outcomes with nuisance estimation; constrained treatment-policy class.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Budgeted causal utility is known; a retrieval contribution must go beyond that objective.

title: Evaluating Treatment Prioritization Rules via Rank-Weighted Average Treatment Effects
authors: Steve Yadlowsky and Scott Fleming and Nigam Shah and Emma Brunskill and Stefan Wager
evidence_sections: Section 2: TOC, RATE, weighted-ATE representation and estimation; Section 2.3 causal scores
specific_claims: Defines TOC/RATE, relates ranking metrics, and derives inference using causal scores for fixed prioritization rules.
context_mechanism: Evaluation of a frozen ranking, not model fitting.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Use honest ranking evaluation; conditional inference does not cover training-seed variability.

title: Rank-Learner: Orthogonal Ranking of Treatment Effects
authors: Henri Arno and Dennis Frauen and Emil Javurek and Thomas Demeester and Stefan Feuerriegel
evidence_sections: Sections 5-6: orthogonal loss and two-stage learner; Appendix F.3: sensitivity to pseudo-label clipping
specific_claims: Learns treatment-effect rankings with a pairwise orthogonal loss, cross-fitted nuisances and sampled training pairs.
context_mechanism: Direct ranking model rather than context selector.
label_compute_budget: Cross-fitted nuisance training and sampled pairs of observed training records; no oracle individual effects.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Orthogonal ranking itself is not new; use as a strong no-FM baseline.

title: Learning to Rank for Uplift Modeling
authors: Floris Devriendt and Jente Van Belle and Tias Guns and Wouter Verbeke
venue_status: IEEE TKDE 34(10), 4888–4904; preprint 2020 has a different author list
specific_claims: Optimizes uplift rankings through LambdaMART and promoted cumulative gain; reports that targeting-depth optimization did not generalize in its experiments.
context_mechanism: Direct learning-to-rank.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Direct uplift ranking predates Rank-Learner; its orthogonality is the newer distinction.

title: Improving uplift model evaluation on randomized controlled trial data
authors: Björn Bokelmann and Stefan Lessmann
venue_status: European Journal of Operational Research 313(2); preprint 2022
evidence_sections: Sections 3-4: evaluation variance and outcome adjustment; Appendix C: metric families
specific_claims: Analyzes variance of uplift evaluation and develops outcome-adjustment procedures that can reduce it under stated conditions.
context_mechanism: Evaluation adjustment, not selected training contexts.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Use variance reduction before launching noisy rare-outcome selector comparisons.

title: Uplift Modeling with High Class Imbalance
authors: Otto Nyberg and Tomasz Kuśmierczyk and Arto Klami
evidence_sections: Sections 2-4: types of imbalance, undersampling and calibration
specific_claims: Introduces model-agnostic undersampling for rare conversion uplift and addresses calibration.
context_mechanism: Outcome-dependent training-sample selection.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Outcome balancing is prior art and can alter calibration.

title: Exploring uplift modeling with high class imbalance
authors: Otto Nyberg and Arto Klami
evidence_sections: Sections 1-2: distinction between outcome imbalance and treatment imbalance; undersampling and calibration method sections
specific_claims: Studies undersampling strategies for imbalanced uplift and corrections for their probability distortion.
context_mechanism: Training distribution modification based on outcome.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Distinguish rare outcomes from unequal treatment-arm sizes and confounding.

title: Heteroscedasticity-aware stratified sampling to improve uplift modeling
authors: Björn Bokelmann and Stefan Lessmann
venue_status: European Journal of Operational Research 325(1), 118-131, 2025; preprint 2024
evidence_sections: Sections 3-4: variance components and HS-sampling; Appendix C: evaluation and confidence intervals
specific_claims: Uses heteroskedasticity-aware pre-experiment stratified sampling to improve treatment-effect estimation and uplift evaluation.
context_mechanism: Experimental sample acquisition, not labelled inference memory.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Sampling by informativeness/noise already exists; adaptation to a frozen FM is a separate question.

title: Rethinking Causal Ranking: A Balanced Perspective on Uplift Model Evaluation
authors: Minqin Zhu and Zexu Sun and Ruoxuan Xiong and Anpeng Wu and Baohong Li and Caizhi Tang and Jun Zhou and Fei Wu and Kun Kuang
specific_claims: Proposes PUC/PUL and PTONet, addressing treatment/outcome contributions in binary-outcome ranking metrics.
context_mechanism: Alternative objective and metric, not context retrieval.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Metric choice can change model ranking; this is not a proof every conventional Qini estimand is invalid.

title: Uplift Model Evaluation with Ordinal Dominance Graphs
authors: Brecht Verbeken and Marie-Anne Guerry and Wouter Verbeke and Sam Verboven
specific_claims: Develops ROCini/pROCini via ordinal dominance graphs, incorporates negative outcomes and derives confidence bounds.
context_mechanism: Uplift metric construction.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Include metric sensitivity as a diagnostic rather than choosing a favorable metric afterwards.

title: Causal Isotonic Calibration for Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
authors: Lars Van Der Laan and Ernesto Ulloa-Perez and Marco Carone and Alex Luedtke
specific_claims: Calibrates black-box heterogeneous-effect predictions using causal isotonic calibration and cross-calibration with doubly robust rates.
context_mechanism: Post-processing of effect predictions.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Ranking quality and effect calibration are distinct; calibration alone is not new context selection.

title: Empirical Analysis of Model Selection for Heterogeneous Causal Effect Estimation
authors: Divyat Mahajan and Ioannis Mitliagkas and Brady Neal and Vasilis Syrgkanis
specific_claims: Benchmarks surrogate CATE model-selection metrics with tuning and realistic generative datasets; considers causal ensembles.
context_mechanism: Selection of estimators rather than donor subsets.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Selecting a context using observed validation outcomes is itself a causal model-selection problem.

title: Do Contemporary Causal Inference Models Capture Real-World Heterogeneity? Findings from a Large-Scale Benchmark
authors: Haining Yu and Yizhou Sun
specific_claims: Benchmarks CATE estimators using observational sampling and a real-data statistic preserving MSE model rankings.
context_mechanism: Real-outcome benchmarking.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Include zero and constant-effect controls; conclusions concern the tested design, not all causal estimators.

title: UpliftBench: Revealing Outcome-Regime and Objective Mismatch in Uplift Evaluation
authors: Binshuang Li
specific_claims: Examines effect-accuracy/ranking alignment and sign-threshold versus budgeted-value objectives; explicitly bounds findings to particular datasets and objectives.
context_mechanism: Multi-objective evaluation protocol.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Do not generalize IHDP metric disagreement or Jobs threshold behavior to every uplift task.
code_status: primary arXiv outbound link opened; code not executed

title: Estimation and Inference of Heterogeneous Treatment Effects using Random Forests
authors: Stefan Wager and Susan Athey
specific_claims: Develops causal forests with treatment-effect consistency and asymptotic inference under assumptions, comparing against matching in experiments.
context_mechanism: Adaptive neighborhood estimation, not a pretrained FM.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: A learned neighborhood for causal estimation predates FM retrieval.

title: Bridging the Gap: A Systematic Benchmarking of Uplift Modeling and Heterogeneous Treatment Effects Methods
authors: Jannik Rößler and Detlef Schoder
evidence_sections: Benchmark evaluation protocol; discussion of unscaled Qini and practical targeting
specific_claims: Compares uplift and HTE methods under a common benchmark and discusses metrics and practical targeting.
context_mechanism: Cross-method benchmark.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: A shared protocol and classical controls are established requirements, not standalone novelty.

title: About evaluation metrics for contextual uplift modeling
authors: Christophe Renaudin and Matthieu Martin
specific_claims: Studies uplift evaluation with logged bandit data, variance reduction and propensity adjustments outside randomized trials.
context_mechanism: Context means decision covariates, not FM demonstrations.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: Distinguish logged-policy selection bias from duplicate-vector leakage.

title: In Search of Insights, Not Magic Bullets: Towards Demystification of the Model Selection Dilemma in Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation
authors: Alicia Curth and Mihaela van der Schaar
specific_claims: Investigates success and failure modes of CATE selection criteria and their dependence on candidate models and data.
context_mechanism: Causal model selection rather than context-row selection.
label_compute_budget: No frozen-FM context-memory budget specified; see original task scope.
limitations: Does not itself establish a new causal-FM context selection algorithm.
relevance_to_novelty: A universal selector or selection metric should not be assumed.

title: Transformers Can Do Bayesian Inference
authors: Samuel Müller and Noah Hollmann and Sebastian Pineda Arango and Josif Grabocka and Frank Hutter
evidence_sections: Original primary abstract and official authors repository BibTeX
specific_claims: Introduces prior-data fitted networks trained on sampled supervised tasks to approximate posterior predictive inference from set-valued context.
context_mechanism: Synthetic-prior meta-training and set-conditioned prediction.
label_compute_budget: Large offline training precedes single-forward task prediction.
limitations: Approximation depends on the sampled prior; not a causal-effect identification guarantee.
relevance_to_novelty: Foundational source for the PFN context-conditioning paradigm.

title: Vector Search As Nearest Neighbor Matching: RAG-based Policy Learning in Causal Inference
authors: Masahiro Kato and Taka Kato
specific_claims: Connects action-specific RAG to causal matching and decomposes policy regret.
context_mechanism: Per-action embedding kNN, then generator or plug-in decision.
label_compute_budget: Binary experiments use 6+6 retrieved reports; multi-action experiments use unequal additional evidence.
limitations: Synthetic experiments; prediction-error assumptions do not guarantee arbitrary generators.
relevance_to_novelty: Direct prior; does not learn cohort-budgeted context-swap utility.

title: Learning Representations for Counterfactual Inference
authors: Fredrik Johansson and Uri Shalit and David Sontag
evidence_sections: Introduction: counterfactual inference as domain adaptation
specific_claims: Frames counterfactual inference through domain adaptation and representation learning.
context_mechanism: Balances learned representations across treatment populations; not FM memory selection.
label_compute_budget: Training estimator weights on observational data.
limitations: Not a frozen-FM subset method; introduction inspected without independent proof audit.
relevance_to_novelty: Causal balance and representation learning are established antecedents.

title: Estimating individual treatment effect: generalization bounds and algorithms
authors: Uri Shalit and Fredrik D. Johansson and David Sontag
specific_claims: Relates treatment-effect error to factual generalization and representation IPM, including MMD and Wasserstein, under stated assumptions.
context_mechanism: Learned balanced representation and outcome prediction, not context/target herding.
label_compute_budget: Estimator training and balancing penalty.
limitations: Does not establish finite-context accuracy of an arbitrary frozen transformer; proofs not independently audited.
relevance_to_novelty: MMD-based causal balance alone is not a new selection principle.
